title: Jason Palmer
description: "Although no match for our Jedi," states Jason Palmer, "the Rancor was perhaps the most fearsome creature to come out of the STAR WARS trilogy." Born and raised in Los Angeles, Palmer began working professionally in comics in 1991, painting covers for LOST IN SPACE, THE GREEN HORNET, STAR TREK trade paperbacks, DEBT OF HONOR and THE STARLOST. Recent assignments include pencilling covers for DC's STAR TREK: THE NEXT GENERATION and a series of STAR WARS pOsters with Hasson Productions.
